newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Asia bond, currency fund offers shares at $10.
newsitem.headline: Asia bond, currency fund offers shares at $10.

text.p: Luxembourg-incorporated Asia Bond and Currency Fund said it would offer shares in the Fund at $10 each between March 17 and 19 to be listed on the Luxembourg bourse and the Osaka Securities Exchange.

The closed-end fund aimed "to provide stable long-term income through investment in Asian currency-denominated and linked instruments," it said in a preliminary placing memorandum received on Monday. No less than 65 percent of the net asset value would be invested in fixed income securities.
No details were given on the likely size of the issue.
The minimum individual subscription is 100 shares.
The shares have been accepted for clearance through Cedel Bank and Euroclear.
Nikko Securities Co Ltd is global coordinator.
